title: French Beef Fillet Madeleine
description: A classic French dish featuring tender beef fillet in a rich Madeleine-inspired sauce, served with a side of sautéed vegetables.
instructions: Season beef fillet with salt and black pepper.
Dust beef fillet with flour, shaking off excess.
Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear beef fillet until browned on both sides, then transfer to a baking sheet.
Bake beef fillet in the oven for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
While beef is cooking, make the Madeleine-inspired sauce.
In a saucepan, melt the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and carrot to the saucepan and cook until tender.
Add heavy cream to the saucepan and bring to a simmer.
Stir in Madeleine cake mix until dissolved.
Season sauce with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve beef fillet with Madeleine-inspired sauce spooned over the top.
